result.answer: According to the demo bed-management system, the patient is admitted on WARD-C, bed BAY1-07. We know this because Shutter read that system's own record for the encounter. The record shows two movements in order. First, the admission to WARD-A, bed BAY1-01, at 08:00 UTC on 15 Oct 2026. Second, the transfer to WARD-C, bed BAY1-07, at 08:45 UTC, which is now the latest version of the record. The failed transfer to WARD-B, bay 2 bed 04 (08:20 UTC), is not in that record. The system also has no receipt for it, so it never took effect. The PAS feed agrees with this order: it sent the admission, then the WARD-B transfer (which failed), then the WARD-C transfer (which was applied). One limit: this is what the systems recorded. Shutter cannot see where the patient physically is. If the ward says the patient is not on WARD-C, a person should check with the PAS.
